commander: Autonomously sweep assigned sectors to locate and extract all twelve survivors, using physical runners to base (7,7) and nearby rescuers to bridge communication blackouts.

intents.S1: Sweep NW; if cut off, keep sweeping, relay survivor coords directly to R1, and return to base (7,7) every 15 ticks.
intents.S2: Sweep NE; when cut off, keep sweeping, carry survivor locations directly to R2, and visit base (7,7) every 20 ticks.
intents.S3: Sweep SW; when cut off, keep sweeping, deliver survivor coords to R1 or base (7,7) every 15 ticks to reconnect.
intents.S4: Sweep SE; while dark, keep sweeping until 3 survivors found or tick 40, then carry news to R2 and base.
intents.R1: Rescue in West half avoiding water; if cut off, sweep nearby dry land and check base (7,7) for scout reports.
intents.R2: Rescue in East half avoiding water; when cut off, follow S2/S4 leads and pass base (7,7) when queue is empty.
